status: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-11-09, committed before the judged run. Criteria were set from the plan (docs/MORPHOGENESIS_PLAN.md, 'First experiments, pre-registration elements') and from theory. Two design changes followed development runs and were accepted by the lead before any judged run: the time-step observation times moved earlier (dev-02 errors at 3600 and 14400 s sat at the round-off floor), and the A6 resolution floor moved from 1e-12 to 1e-14 after the reference floor was measured (1.4e-15 to 4e-15). No physics threshold changed.
question: Does a decaying morphogen spreading from a source on fixed tissue reproduce the gradient: the exact discrete steady state, the continuum decay length lambda = sqrt(D/k) on a regular strip, its scaling with D/k and its convergence under grid refinement, with conserved mass?
command: PYTHONPATH=src:. JAX_ENABLE_X64=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= taskset -c 0,1 python -m validation.morphogenesis.mg0a_gradient all --output RUN_DIR --protocol THIS_FILE

model_mapping.morphogen: species A: contact transport g = D h l/d (two-point flux), decay A -> B at k, reverse rate 0
model_mapping.product: species B: immobile (permeability 0); its amount is the decay ledger
model_mapping.source: one reservoir cell, volume 1e6 pL, initial A 1 fmol/pL, no decay, ordinary contacts to the tissue; it drains at the exact slowest-mode rate mu (mu/k about 4e-7), which the primary reference includes
model_mapping.horizon: 40/k from the empty start (other modes decay by at least e^-40)
model_mapping.step: largest power of two with h*alpha <= 0.4 (the model admits 0.5)

parameters.source_values: Kicheva et al. 2007 Science 315:521 (wing-disc Dpp; research-verified.json claim C1c): lambda 20.2 +/- 5.7 um = 7.7 cells, D 0.10 um^2/s, k 2.52e-4 1/s
parameters.continuum_lambda_um: sqrt(0.10/2.52e-4) = 19.92 (7.59 cells); the measured 20.2 um is reported as context, not judged
parameters.strip: 64 cells (8.4 lambda), reservoir as cell 0 at the strip's cell spacing
parameters.scaling: D/k x0.25, x1, x4 (D varied, k fixed); strips of 64, 64 and 160 cells
parameters.refinement: cell width 2a, a, a/2 on the same physical strip (32, 64, 128 cells), D and k fixed. An a/4 level (3.2e5 steps) is not used: in development run dev-01 the engine's step-count-independent closed-world balance guard refused it on accumulated reservoir rounding (recorded as an engine gap)
parameters.timestep: 64-cell strip, dt 16, 8, 4, 2, 1 s, observed at 300, 600 and 900 s against the exact transient. The first draft observed at 900, 3600 and 14400 s; development run dev-02 showed the later errors at the round-off floor (1e-15), which A6_resolution would have reported as unresolved, so the observation times were moved earlier before any judged run. The thresholds were not changed
parameters.polygon: Voronoi tissue of a jittered hexagonal lattice: 12 x 40 cells, spacing 2.623 um, jitter +/-0.2 spacing, seed 0; reservoir coupled to the first lattice column
parameters.cut: 64-cell strip; contact 12-13 closed at t_cut = 40/k, reopened 5/k later (cut_and_restore), never reopened (cut_without_restore), or never closed (no_cut); horizon 40/k after the restore time

references.primary: Exact slowest eigenmode of the discrete linear system (finite reservoir included), computed in the driver with scipy: rate mu from the secular equation (brentq), tissue shape phi from a sparse direct solve. The engine's late profile c/c_reservoir is compared cell by cell.
references.transient: Exact piecewise solution by symmetric eigendecomposition (scipy.linalg.eigh), including decay and contact ledgers.
references.continuum: lambda = sqrt(D/k); discrete exponent lambda_d = a/arccosh(1 + (k - mu) a^2/(2D)); predicted discretisation error (a/lambda)^2/24 (0.07% at the Kicheva values)
references.independence: No Cells numerical, topology or schedule code is used by the references; only the definition JSON is shared.

observables.profile_vs_exact_rel_max: max over tissue cells of |c_i/c_0 / phi_i - 1| at the horizon
observables.lambda_cosh_fit: least-squares fit of C0 cosh((L - x)/lambda)/cosh(L/lambda), L = (n + 1/2) a, to the engine's strip profile
observables.log_slope_lambda_vs_D_over_k: slope of ln(lambda_fit) against ln(D/k) over the three scaling cases
observables.observed_orders (refinement): log2 ratio of |lambda_fit/sqrt(D/k) - 1| between successive halvings of a
observables.observed_orders (timestep): log2 ratio of the norm-wise transient error between successive halvings of dt
observables.tissue_mass_balance_rel_max: |tissue (A + B) - net source-contact transfer| / net source transfer, over observations after t = 0
observables.closed_world_total_rel_max: |total A + B - initial total| / initial total
observables.transient_normwise_rel_error: max |A_engine - A_exact| / max |A_exact| over tissue cells, cut arms, at each observation time after t = 0
observables.distal_max_over_source: isolated distal fragment, cut without restore: max c/c_reservoir at the horizon

controls.no_cut: same schedule grid, contacts never closed: late profile equals phi
controls.cut_without_restore: proximal fragment reaches the exact truncated-strip mode; the source-free distal fragment decays
controls.uniform_state: not applicable to MG0a: the linear steady state is unique

criteria.basis: plan: discrete profile within 1e-9 relative of the exact linear-system solution
as A1, on the polygon tissue
plan: continuum lambda within 1% on a regular strip; predicted error 0.29% at the shortest (3.8-cell) lambda
continuum slope 1/2; the discrete correction lowers it by about (a/lambda)^2/12 averaged over the range, at most 0.003

classical RK4 is fourth order; judged on the two finest pairs (4->2 s, 2->1 s) at 300, 600 and 900 s. If any error in those pairs is below 1e-14 (A6_resolution) the criterion is reported as unresolved, not passed

A6 is resolved only if every error in its two finest pairs is at least 1e-14, 2.5 to 7 times the eigendecomposition reference's measured floor (1.4e-15 to 4e-15 where the RK4 error vanishes, dev-02). If this fails, A6 is reported as unresolved and the protocol does not pass. The first draft used 1e-12, set before the floor was measured; dev-05's smallest finest-pair error was 1.0e-13, with order 4.04.
positivity of the closed linear system at h*alpha <= 0.5
unique linear steady state: restored profile equals the uncut one (machinery check, not memory)
proximal fragment of the unrestored cut equals its exact truncated-strip mode
source-free fragment decays at rate >= k for 45/k (exact about 3e-20)
RK4 transient error at h*alpha <= 0.4 across the cut and restore events; generous bound, not a fitted tolerance; t = 0 is excluded (both solutions are exactly zero in the empty tissue)

reported_not_judged: polygon diagnostic_effective_lambda_um (two-point flux on Voronoi cells; no continuum criterion off the regular strip)
runtime_checks (engine's own balance and accounting guards), wall time, peak RSS
engine_gaps_recorded: reaction_transport@1 has no source term; the source is a large-volume reservoir cell
reaction_transport@1 has no excision or replacement event contract (core/excision.py covers surface_* families only); the cut is contact closure, i.e. isolation, not removal

reaction_transport@1 closed-world balance guard (512 eps x initial total, models/reaction_transport.py check_values) does not grow with the step count; with a dominant reservoir, per-step rounding drifts the total (ratio to the guard 0.026 at 2e4 steps, 0.071 at 8e4) and a 3.2e5-step run was refused (dev-01, refinement a/4). Proposed minimal change: allow rounding per accepted step, e.g. 512 eps x total x max(1, sqrt(steps)), or compensated summation of the amount update
outcome_rules: Pass if every judged criterion passes. A failure is recorded with its results and kept; any revised protocol gets a new id (v2) and is reported as weaker evidence. A6 unresolved is reported as such and does not count as a pass.
resources: CPUs 0-1, CPU backend only, RSS below 4 GiB; expected under 10 minutes

development_runs.dev-01-mg0a: first pass; refinement a/4 refused by the engine's closed-world balance guard (kept as evidence); cut arm failed on a driver windowing bug (fixed)
development_runs.dev-02-mg0a: all parts ran; late time-step observations at the round-off floor (design fixed: earlier times)
development_runs.dev-05-mg0a-timestep: time-step and cut parts after the fixes
